name: Nyotai-ka Panic! ~Onna no Ko no Karada tte Kimochi Ii~
original_name: 女体化パニック！ ～オンナのコのカラダってキモチイイ～
source: When Hiroki wakes up to find he's swapped into the body of the most beautiful girl in school Shingyouji Sakurako he thinks it's a dream come true until he discovers that she's expected to have sex with her father and two brothers every day! Will he escape or drown in pleasure?
translation: 宏树醒来后发现自己变成了学校最漂亮的女孩——新行寺樱子。他以为梦想成真，却发现樱子每天都必须和父亲及两个哥哥发生性关系！他能逃离，还是会沉溺于快感？
